text:
Priya_marketing: Quick heads-up  launching a tiny EU-only pricing calculator experiment for next Wed's webinar. Need: micro-FAQ refresh, final tier labels, CTA variants, and routing rules. Low risk. Who can pick up which piece?
Jorge_growth: I can do analytics + event mapping. Plan to A/B the CTA and default usage. Drop the copy somewhere and I'll wire events.
Hannah_content: I'll draft 3 micro-FAQ Qs (<=2 lines each): overages, reserved capacity, and data handling. Will keep tone concise and EU-friendly.
Zoe_design: I'll create CTA treatments and a light CSS swap for tier badges. Can we avoid new icons to keep it fast?
Nate_analytics: Propose defaults: Variant A: 25,000 tokens, Variant B: 75,000 tokens. CTAs: A = "Estimate my cost", B = "Show my monthly price". Track metrics: click -> demo signup -> MQL. Also capture utm_variant.
Priya_marketing: Good. For routing: utm_region=EU route to EU-SDR. If estimated_monthly_cost > 800 -> escalate to AE_EU. @Leo_sales ok with threshold?
Leo_sales: 800 EUR seems reasonable for AE touch. Happy to review list if we get >20 leads/day.
Compliance_bot: Reminder: any comparative or savings language must be qualified (e.g., "typical savings"), and include GDPR/customer-data note in the FAQ. Legal needs final copy 24h prior to publish.
Hannah_content: Draft micro-FAQ:
Q: How are overages billed?
A: Overage usage is billed monthly at your plan's per-token rate; we notify at 80% of your commitment.
Q: Can I reserve dedicated capacity?
A: Yes Dedicated pools available on application. Contact sales to enable.
Q: How is EU customer data handled?
A: We store logs in EU regions by default and offer GDPR-compliant controls (DPA + KMS).
Zoe_design: FR/DE translation note: keep main lines <= 80 chars to avoid wrapping on mobile. I'll provide assets.
Nate_analytics: Small experiment payload I'll push to Optimizely (example):
```
experiment = {
  "name": "eu_pricing_calc_mini",
  "variants": ["A", "B"],
  "defaults": {"tokens": 25000},
  "goals": ["cta_click","signup","mql_created"],
  "utm_params": ["utm_campaign","utm_variant","utm_region"]
}
```
Priya_marketing: Nice. Ops note: utm_campaign=eu_pricing_mini, utm_variant=A|B, utm_region=EU. @Nate_analytics please ensure events include utm_variant.
Jorge_growth: Adding segmentation: returning users vs new accounts; also flag >10k monthly usage visitors. We'll compare conversion rates.
Priya_marketing: Tier label quick test idea: "Launch / Scale / Enterprise" vs "Build / Grow / Enterprise". Which reads clearer for dev-led SMBs? Low lift to swap labels in CSS.
Zoe_design: I prefer "Build / Grow / Enterprise"  feels more product-y and translates better. Will create a quick mock.
Compliance_bot: Also flag: public-facing numbers (benchmarks) need a qualifier and small hardware footnote if used on slides.
Hannah_content: I'll add the benchmark qualifier to the FAQ draft: "Typical savings on common generation workloads vs default configs; results vary by prompt and model."
Priya_marketing: Timeline: copy ready by EOD Friday, design assets by Monday AM, Optimizely wired Monday afternoon, deploy Tuesday AM, monitor live Wed webinar. Legal to sign off 24h before deploy.
Leo_sales: Also add an SFDC lead field for utm_variant so we can report by variant.
Nate_analytics: Will add SFDC mapping and a dashboard tile for variant performance.
Priya_marketing: Thanks team. Action items: Hannah (FAQ), Zoe (assets + translations note), Nate (experiment + SFDC mapping), Jorge (segmentation dashboards), Compliance_bot/Legal (review). Post drafts here when ready. :rocket:
